title: A Long-term Follow-up Study of Gaucher Disease
official: A Long-term Follow-up Study of Gaucher Disease
summary: The study aims are to: a) identify the long-term natural history of Gaucher disease, b) evaluate long-term treatment efficacy of enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) and substrate reduction therapy (SRT), and c) identify potential long-term complications of this disorder. These aims will be accomplished through long-term record review of individuals with all three types of Gaucher disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Gaucher Disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not meeting Inclusion criteria
